integrity.computational_check: All 253 finite cases up to ambient dimension 6 independently checked by convex hull; 2204 facets checked for codimension one
integrity.proof: Dirichlet integral and Euclidean facet cofactor factors; not a finite enumeration argument

scientific_limitations: Only ordinary Euclidean area in the canonical, unscaled coordinate embedding is covered.
The exact profile is for rankwise chain-order interpolation of ordinal sums of nonempty antichains, not arbitrary decompositions.
Endpoint area formulas and combinatorial face-count monotonicity are existing results; priority of the intermediate area profile is provisional.
No independent scientific audit has been conducted.
title: Reversed Euclidean boundary-area monotonicity across layered chain-order polytopes
